items.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued October 6 at 3:38PM PDT until October 8 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description: * WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with high temperatures ranging from the mid 80s to mid 90s. Nights will be very warm with low temperatures in the upper 60s to low 70s.  * WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas.  * WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT Thursday.  * IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during extreme heat events.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Do not leave young children and pets in unattended vehicles. Car
interiors will reach lethal temperatures in a matter of minutes.

items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 6 at 12:58PM PDT until October 9 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description: * WHAT...For the Beach Hazards Statement, dangerous rip currents expected. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding expected.  * WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County Coastal Areas.  * WHEN...For the Beach Hazards Statement, from this afternoon through Friday evening. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 6 AM Wednesday to 11 AM PDT Friday.  * IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only isolated road closures expected. Minor coastal erosion is also expected. Additionally, elevated surf will lead to strong rip currents.  * ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Elevated surf of 3-5 feet, with sets to 6 feet, on south- and southwest-facing beaches. High tides are expected to peak between 6.5 and 7.0 feet during the mornings and evenings.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.
